intent_snapshot.goal: unified-lane-sessions S2 (#570; Spec docs/specs/unified-lane-sessions.spec.md D5, D6, D7, D10, D19, BR-DEC-3, BR-DEC-5, BR-REQ-3, BR-REQ-4). Add role-indexed runtime/session/provider_registry.ts (roles: executor, authority, advisory) and pure resolveSessionProvider({ role, providers, host, env, registry }): herdr requires HERDR_ENV=1 and non-empty HERDR_WORKSPACE_ID and declares executor hosts claude-code, pi, antigravity with workspace local_path, find_by_key true, and exit_proof true; herdr-core declares executor hosts [] and exit_proof false until #495; fake stays test-only. Extend SupervisedSessionPort with optional CreateSessionInput.session_key ([a-z0-9-], 1-64 chars), trailing-12-char herdrAgentName suffix uniqueness, findSession(session_key) (using herdr tab list --workspace on herdr), and idempotent closeWithProof(handle, session_key) that verifies live [imm:<session_key>] ownership before pane/tab close and proves crash re-entry via pane_not_found + findSession === not_found. Enforce across all registered descriptors in tests/supervised-session-conformance.test.ts.

acceptance.assertion: In tests/session-provider-registry.test.ts and tests/supervised-session-herdr.test.ts: the config-visible registry lists exactly herdr and herdr-core; herdr requires HERDR_ENV=1 and non-empty HERDR_WORKSPACE_ID and declares roles.executor with claude-code, pi, antigravity, workspace local_path, find_by_key true, and exit_proof true; herdr-core declares roles.executor hosts [] and exit_proof false; runSessionCli builds adapters from the registry and rejects --provider fake or --provider unknown_name with invalid_input.

In tests/session-provider-registry.test.ts: resolveSessionProvider for role executor with ["herdr", "herdr-core"] selects herdr when HERDR_ENV=1 and HERDR_WORKSPACE_ID=ws1, refuses lane_session_unavailable listing both providers and recoveries when HERDR_ENV is unset or HERDR_WORKSPACE_ID is empty, selects herdr-core outside Herdr when an injected descriptor admits pi while refusing claude-code, skips descriptors with find_by_key false (reason no find_by_key), and invokes zero adapter factory, probe, or createSession calls.

In tests/supervised-session-conformance.test.ts, across every registered descriptor under its fake CLI and fake: createSession with session_key binds it into session identity and rejects uppercase, underscore, empty, or 65-char keys with invalid_input; findSession returns that handle or not_found; repeated closeWithProof(handle, session_key) calls return the same exited proof bound to handle and session_key while a mismatched session_key returns not_owned; an injected descriptor claiming find_by_key or exit_proof without implementing the method fails.

In tests/supervised-session-herdr.test.ts: createSession with session_key writes [imm:<session_key>] into the tab label; herdrAgentName uses the trailing 12 characters so two sibling keys sharing a 20-character prefix produce distinct agent names; findSession queries herdr tab list --workspace; closeWithProof verifies live [imm:<session_key>] before closing pane and tab, returns exited proof on crash re-entry when pane get is pane_not_found and tab list finds no matching key, and refuses not_owned without closing when a live tab carries another key. Existing herdr-core and advisory tests pass.

docs/reference/supervised-session-port.md, docs/adr/0038-supervised-session-port.md, and CONTEXT.md document resolveSessionProvider, session_key, findSession, closeWithProof, and lane_session_unavailable.
Claude bundle, Antigravity artifact, dist reference mirrors, and repository typecheck are current.

In tests/supervised-session-boundary.test.ts: runtime/session/ imports only its own modules and node:* builtins, session imports stay inside allowed callers, and no runtime file outside runtime/session/ compares a provider name literal.

intent_snapshot.scope_size_reason: Role-indexed provider descriptors, the Port primitives honoring them (session_key, findSession, closeWithProof) across herdr, herdr-core, and fake, and the conformance suite verifying declaration-to-adapter parity form one atomic session contract alongside its ADR and reference docs.

attestations.summary: Registry descriptors, pure resolveSessionProvider (no factory/probe calls, lane_session_unavailable with per-provider reasons), session_key validation, herdr tab-label binding with trailing-12 agent names, findSession via tab list --workspace, idempotent closeWithProof with crash re-entry and not_owned on foreign/re-keyed tabs, fake and herdr-core parity, docs/ADR/CONTEXT and byte-identical Antigravity mirrors all match SPR-A1..A7; blast radius medium: runtime/session port contract (supervised_session_port.ts, herdr_provider.ts, provider_registry.ts, cli.ts) with no persisted-shape change.

advisory_findings.summary: herdr-core closeWithProof accepts a keyless terminal when session_key equals its random owner token, contradicting its own comment that a missing key label means mismatch; harmless today since herdr-core admits no executor host.

evidence.trigger: herdr-core terminal created without session_key (owner label = newToken() value matching [a-z0-9-]) → closeWithProof(handle, <that owner token>) kills and removes it and returns an exited proof instead of not_owned

findings.summary: herdr closeWithProof crash re-entry closes any tab whose label carries the key (not the handle's tab), ignores tab close failure, and still returns an exited proof; it must prove exit only when tab list finds no matching key

evidence.trigger: session A created with session_key k (tab t1/pane p1) crashes so pane get is pane_not_found and t1 is gone; a retry createSession with the same k makes live tab t2/pane p2; closeWithProof(handleA, k) takes the found.gone branch, tab list finds t2 ending in [imm:k], runs herdr tab close t2 without checking tab_id === ids.tab or that t2's pane is dead, discards the close exit code, and returns {ok:true, exited:true} -> the live re-created Executor session is killed, and when tab close fails the port returns an exit proof while a live session still carries [imm:k] (fabricated success vs SessionExitProof contract and the reference doc 'proves exit ... when findSession reports not_found'); no test pins the matching-survivor case
